title: #[non_exhaustive] on CredentialStoreError is correct
description: CredentialStoreError is marked #[non_exhaustive]. This is correct: the error enum is in a library crate and future load paths (e.g., a remote HTTP credential store) will need new variants. Without #[non_exhaustive], adding any variant is a breaking change. A contributor might suggest removing it to simplify match arms — keep it.
